title: Target Server - OTEL export
description: Cost and usage from invoke_workflow traces (target.cost.usd, target.usage.*) plus Prometheus target.* metrics when the destination stores them.

list.name: org
list.label: Organization

query.query: query_result(count by (target_org, org_name) (label_replace(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name!=""}[$__range]), "org_name", "$1", "target_org_name", "(.+)")) or (count by (target_org, org_name) (label_replace(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name=""}[$__range]), "org_name", "$1", "target_org", "(.+)")) unless on (target_org) count by (target_org) (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name!=""}[$__range]))))

list.definition: query_result(count by (target_org, org_name) (label_replace(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name!=""}[$__range]), "org_name", "$1", "target_org_name", "(.+)")) or (count by (target_org, org_name) (label_replace(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name=""}[$__range]), "org_name", "$1", "target_org", "(.+)")) unless on (target_org) count by (target_org) (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org_name!=""}[$__range]))))
list.description: Shows the organization name (target.org.name, sent when the organization's Send content is on) and falls back to the id for series without it. The value used in queries is always the id (target_org).

list.name: window
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Window of increase()/rate(). Use a longer window when exports are infrequent.

panels.title: Cost (USD) by org and runner
panels.description: Exported cost over the selected time range: last value of target_cost_usd_USD_total minus its value before the range (priced at the moment each snapshot was exported; unpriced runners have no cost series). Counter resets (Collector restart) count as zero.

targets.expr: sum by (org, target_runner) (label_replace(label_replace(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_cost_usd_USD_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_cost_usd_USD_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_cost_usd_USD_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0), "org", "$1", "target_org", "(.+)"), "org", "$1", "target_org_name", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Workflow failure rate
panels.description: failed / (completed + failed) over the selected time range, from target_workflow_failed_total and target_workflow_completed_total.

targets.expr: (sum(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0)) or vector(0)) / ((sum(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0)) or vector(0)) + (sum(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0)) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Workflows completed vs failed
panels.description: Workflows that reached a terminal status in the selected time range: last value of target_workflow_completed_total / target_workflow_failed_total minus its value before the range. Counter resets (Collector restart) count as zero.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_workflow_completed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0)) or vector(0)

sum(clamp_min(last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[7d] offset $__range) or (last_over_time(target_workflow_failed_total{target_org=~"$org", target_runner=~"$runner"}[$__range]) * 0)), 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tokens per hour by token type
panels.description: Tokens added per hour, from target_tokens_total. input is uncached input; the four types are disjoint.

panels.title: Step duration p50 / p95
panels.description: Step duration quantiles from target_step_duration_seconds_bucket (histogram bounds 1s to 3600s, so quantiles are interpolated inside a bucket).

panels.title: Step retries
panels.description: Retries consumed by steps that finished, from target_step_retries_total, per runner.

panels.title: Workflow cost and usage (traces)
panels.description: Root invoke_workflow spans from Tempo. Cost and tokens are span attributes (target.cost.usd, target.usage.*), so this table works when only traces are exported. Unpriced workflows omit cost. Click a workflow name to open the trace.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "target-server" && name =~ "invoke_workflow.*" } | select(span.target.cost.usd, span.target.usage.input_tokens, span.target.usage.output_tokens, span.target.workflow.status, span.target.runner, resource.target.org.name, resource.target.org)
